recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed for FHIR-36636 unless FHIR-I later decides to strengthen document update policy beyond the current SHOULD guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-36636 was Published / Not Persuasive with Modification. It asked for normative SHALL language that a Document Bundle is immutable, but FHIR-I decided not to enforce blanket immutability and instead approved nuanced wording about frozen document instance contents, SHOULD-level update/new-document policies, attestation risk, and Bundle.identifier for additional documents derived from the same Composition.
initial_application: Commit 0a729198e07df0fc13d938dd88810142dbabdc6b, later merged through PR #2344, changed source/documents.html to replace the old absolute immutable/document-id text with the FHIR-36636 resolution wording. No prior Issue-Reconcile-Key commit for FHIR-36636 existed on the combined branch before this audit.
additional_context: The triggering Zulip thread shows the old wording caused confusion about normative immutability and the roles of Bundle.id, Bundle.identifier, and Composition.identifier. FHIR-I WGM 202205 minutes record the issue disposition and 14-0-1 motion. Later Published issues FHIR-38927 and FHIR-38930 intentionally changed the same paragraph by removing 'frozen' from the general document definition and deleting the 'document immutability' label sentence, so current source should not exactly match the original FHIR-36636 replacement text.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active source/documents.html now says a FHIR document instance is a Bundle of type document that contains specific frozen versions of resources, warns that Bundle changes may invalidate attestation, gives SHOULD-level policy guidance for updates versus distinct documents, and uses Bundle.identifier for additional documents derived from the same Composition. The obsolete 'Once assembled into a bundle, the document is immutable' and ambiguous 'document id' wording are absent.

related_jiras.note: Published ballot issue that removed 'frozen' from the general document definition while preserving 'specific frozen versions' for document instances.
